label: Issue Area
description: The primary social or environmental issue a Project addresses. Not assumed to be a complete list of every possible issue area -- new values can be proposed as real projects need them.

values.label: Housing
values.definition: Access to safe, stable, and affordable housing.

values.label: Education
values.definition: Access to and quality of learning, from early childhood through adult education.

values.label: Health
values.definition: Physical and behavioral health, including access to care.

values.label: Economic Development
values.definition: Employment, income, and local economic opportunity.

values.label: Food Security
values.definition: Reliable access to sufficient, affordable, nutritious food.

values.label: Human Rights
values.definition: Civil rights, civil liberties, and human-rights advocacy.
